variation.scope: Ties omitted at lifts 7-8, west elevation, behind hoarding

notes.inspector_remark: Tie absent at lift 3, east elevation. No other findings.

deciding.design_conformity: Variation V-114 covers ties omitted at lifts 7-8 west only. The inspector remark places a missing tie at lift 3 east, outside that scope, and 49 ties are fitted against 50 required.
deciding.handover_decision: The tie test passed and no defects are raised, but the inspector card expired two days before the inspection (2025-02-16 vs 2025-02-18). That mitigating pass and the aggravating expiry are in balance, so full release and a hold are both defensible.
deciding.limiting_issue: The single missing tie at lift 3 can be read as a local missing part or as an unapproved departure from the tie design. Nothing in the record decides between them.
deciding.discrepancy_size: Ties fitted 49 against 50 required is exactly 2%, on the boundary between levels 0 and 1.
deciding.releasable_share: The problem sits on one of 8 lifts (lift 3). Readers split between all lifts releasable once the tie is fitted and 7 of 8 releasable now.
